xs = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 200)
ys = f(xs)
plt.plot(xs, ys, label='f(x)')
ys = w(xs)
plt.plot(xs, ys, label='w(x)')
ys = g(xs)
plt.plot(xs, ys, label='f(x)/w(x)')
plt.grid()
plt.legend()

# Simulate

x0 = 0.5
N = 1000000
stepsize = 1.0

store = np.zeros(N)
for i in range(N):
    store[i] = x0
    x1 = x0 + stepsize*(2*np.random.rand()-1.0)
    a = w(x1)/w(x0)
    if a>1:
        x0 = x1
    else:
        p = np.random.rand()
        if p <= a:
            x0 = x1

# Burn-in
burn = 10000
store = store[burn:]

# Histogram (correct normalization)
values, edges = np.histogram(store, bins=50, density=True)
midpoints = 0.5*(edges[:-1] + edges[1:])

plt.plot(midpoints, values, 'o', label='Generated')

plt.legend()
plt.grid()
plt.show()

ys = ys / np.trapz(ys, xs)

plt.plot(xs, ys, label='Target')

# Metropolis
x0 = 0.5
N = 1000000
stepsize = 1.0

store = np.zeros(N)

for i in range(N):
    x1 = x0 + stepsize*(2*np.random.rand()-1.0)
    a = min(1, w(x1)/w(x0))
    
    if np.random.rand() < a:
        x0 = x1
    
    store[i] = x0

# Burn-in
burn = 10000
store = store[burn:]

# Histogram (correct normalization)
values, edges = np.histogram(store, bins=50, density=True)
midpoints = 0.5*(edges[:-1] + edges[1:])

plt.plot(midpoints, values, 'o', label='Generated')

plt.legend()
plt.grid()
plt.show()
